dedupe_keys.name: somalia district level combined drought index and cereal production 2001 2025

description: Linked district-level drought and cereal production records for Somalia. The Zenodo record says the first component is a monthly FAO-SWALIM Combined Drought Index record for 73 districts from January 2001 to December 2025 (21,827 district-months), with its precipitation, temperature and vegetation sub-indices and the satellite rainfall and land surface temperature behind them; the second is seasonal maize and sorghum production in tonnes from FSNAU data for 45 crop districts, for the Gu and Deyr seasons of 2001 to 2025, reconstructed for full coverage and joined by district, year and season. The two Excel files are free to download under CC BY 4.0, published 7 August 2026. Coverage is Somalia. Caveats: production gaps were filled by reconstruction and the data support one study. For simulation it links drought severity to seasonal cereal output, to set loss thresholds in food security models. A related catalogue record is the FAO GIEWS ASIS agricultural stress index.
